statement_en: A sequence of functions $f_n(x):X\to \mathbb{C}$ converges uniformly to a function $f(x):X\to \mathbb{C}$ if and only if for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists a positive integer $N_{\varepsilon}$ such that for all $n,m>N_{\varepsilon}$, $$\sup_{x\in X}|f_n(x)-f_m(x)|<\varepsilon.$$
